about.description: Backend-focused software developer with an M.Sc. in Robotics, interested in building reliable products that turn complex systems and AI capabilities into practical software.

items.description: Currently studying the development of web applications and cloud services.

Studied robotics, embedded systems, artificial intelligence, and electronics. For my master's thesis, I developed a radar-based hand gesture recognition system using Python, TensorFlow, and convolutional neural networks (CNNs). The system achieved 95% classification accuracy with a prediction time of approximately 25 ms.
items.thesis: Implementation of Machine Learning Algorithm for Radar-Based Hand Gesture Recognition
